mapper.sql: id, currency, minor_unit AS minorUnit, rounding_mode AS roundingMode, status, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_currency_spec ORDER BY currency
SELECT FROM t_currency_spec WHERE currency = #{currency} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_currency_spec (id, currency, minor_unit, rounding_mode, status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.currency}, #{row.minorUnit}, #{row.roundingMode}, #{row.status}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_currency_spec SET minor_unit = #{minorUnit}, rounding_mode = #{roundingMode}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{row.id} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'DRAFT'
